en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear. A gurbet (working abroad) farewell song; 'в' туѓина' is a contracted 'во'.

lines.en: Get ready for me, love, a white shirt,

lines.cyr: сокри од око ти солза врела.
lines.lat: sokri od oko ti solza vrela.
lines.en: hide the hot tear from your eye.

lines.cyr: На пат ќе одам утре во зори,
lines.lat: Na pat ḱe odam utre vo zori,
lines.en: I will set out tomorrow at dawn,

lines.cyr: в' туѓина пуста со другари мои.
lines.lat: v' tuǵina pusta so drugari moi.
lines.en: to a bleak foreign land with my comrades.
I leave early before the moon.

lines.cyr: чувај ги мила, ко очите свои.
lines.lat: čuvaj gi mila, ko očite svoi.
lines.en: guard them, dear, like your own eyes.

lines.cyr: Во скут ми седат дечиња мали,
lines.lat: Vo skut mi sedat dečinja mali,
lines.en: In my lap sit little children,

lines.cyr: Како да појдам, срце се кине,
lines.lat: Kako da pojdam, srce se kine,
lines.en: How can I go, my heart is tearing,

lines.cyr: гушни ме ќерко, гушни ме сине.
lines.lat: gušni me ḱerko, gušni me sine.
lines.en: hug me, daughter, hug me, son.
I leave early before the moon.

lines.cyr: чувај ги мила, ко очите свои.
lines.lat: čuvaj gi mila, ko očite svoi.
lines.en: guard them, dear, like your own eyes.
